about: One model per vehicle for showroom.js. No free model of the owner's exact vehicles was reachable, so each bay shows a stand-in (owner, 2026-11-20: "Get a free model of a misc motorcycle and sub if u can't find mine"). lengthM scales the model to the real vehicle's factory length (the spec plate in app.js); rotY turns its nose to +X; paintMaterials take the owner's colour; recolor tones other parts. Credits: CREDITS.md.
